description:
As an affiliate, you have the chance to not only promote our lovely products but also share in our profits. We believe in the power of partnerships and want to reward those who align with our values and interests. Whether you are well-versed in these topics or just starting your journey, we welcome anyone who has a genuine love and passion for some or all of our offerings. We offer an array of ethically sourced crystals, teas, tinctures, sprays, bath salts, ceremonial supplies, jewelry, bulk herbs, and more.

Mackenzie, the visionary behind Mystical Medicinals, LLC, is a holistic wellness and spiritual mentor, herbalist, crystal healer, and Reiki Master. Her passion lies in assisting individuals on their journey towards overall well-being and spiritual growth. At Mystical Medicinals, ethical sourcing is of utmost importance. Mackenzie goes above and beyond, personally knowing the families mining the crystals we procure. Our sourcing practices revolve around collaborating with like-minded, small-scale families and individuals who share our values.

As part of our program, we would love to offer you 10% commission on all product sales (excluding tax and shipping). Furthermore, as a valued member of our team, you will also enjoy a personalized discount for your own use and a delightful welcome package upon joining us!

We will work together to provide you with the tools, information, and posts to be successful, after all, we share in our success!  Guidelines are: Minimum of one post per week for a total of four posts each month Needs to be shared to a minimum of 2 platforms. Acceptable platforms include: Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook.
term_and_condition:
Welcome to Mystical Medicinals! We are so thrilled you are joining our Affiliate program.
These following terms and conditions apply to individuals who are accessing or using the Program both as a merchant (“we” or “merchant”) and an affiliate (“you” or “affiliate”) who refers customers to use product or service from the merchant.
By participating in the Program, the Affiliate agrees to use the Program in the manner specified in, and are bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.
 
1. Approve or Reject the Registration
We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Affiliate Program Registration at our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate Program Registration.
 
2. Commissions and payment
Refer any customer to make a purchase on our website, you will get a commission amount which is calculated based on the Commission structure. The commission amount is dependent on order value and not including extra fees (tax, shipping cost,...).
For an Affiliate to receive a commission, you need to specify the payment details on Settings. The payment schedule will be notified on the Affiliate Guide page.
Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed. Use of the Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy which gives merchants the right to review each and every referral order. The status of the commissions are displayed in the Commission tab, any paid commission will be listed on the Payment tab. Transactions that result in chargebacks or refunds will not be paid out.
 
3. Marketing tool
We may share promotion media such as banners, logos or specific collection promotions to you through the Marketing tool tab. You can download the media or get the HTML embed code in order to share on affiliate channels.
 
4. Removal from the Referral Program
If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they can do so by contacting: mysticalmedicinalsaz@gmail.com.
 
Let's make magic happen and refer!
We're very glad you've made it to the end of this important document.
We wish you all the very best. You can always re-visit these Affiliate Program terms and conditions in the future and if you have any questions you can send email to mysticalmedicinalsaz@gmail.com for support.
